author: Levi Winslow
description:
Someone playing Refractive Entertainment's recently released action-RPG Luminary for less than an hour accused the team of using AI for the game's only voiced character. The player said the voice "killed it" for them. There was just one problem: It wasn't AI. It was actually the developer's wife doing her first-ever voice acting gig.

Refractive Entertainment launched Luminary into Steam Early Access on August 11. It's a resource-gathering action-adventure sandbox with an art style that's giving Fable meets Immortals Fenyx Rising. It's cute-looking and well-received, with a "Mostly Positive" rating out of almost 350 Steam reviews. But for an indie developer who says his game's success lives and dies by its Steam review score, one particular negative review caught the creative director's attention.

On September 10, user NyteKnyte
title: Indie Dev Says “AI” Voice In His Game Was Actually His Wife

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Japanese airline All Nippon Airways (ANA) has unveiled a Pokemon-themed airliner to celebrate the franchise's 30th anniversary this year, and it looks incredible.

The Green Pokemon Jet, as it's called, made its inaugural flight from Haneda to Honolulu today following a big unveiling event--you can see video and images below. The airplane goes well beyond simply getting a Pokemon wrap, though it does have that, too, featuring famous Pokemon like Bulbasaur, along with Pikachu. Because how can you have a Pokemon plane and not include Pikachu? Also on display is Browt, a newer Pokemon coming in Winds and Waves.

Inside the aircraft, there are headrest covers, paper cups, and napkins containing Pokem
title: New Pokemon Plane Looks Incredible, Even Includes Themed Cups And Napkins

author: Levi Winslow
description:
There are quite a few months until Final Fantasy 7 Revelation launches on Nintendo Switch 2, PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. But you're going to want to get your systems ready now because the download for the final showdown between Cloud and Sephiroth may be big.

According to a September 18 VGC Interview with game director Naoki Hamaguchi, the file size for Revelation will "probably" be absolutely massive. So huge, in fact, that Hamaguchi acknowledged that there was no way the game would fit on one--or even two or three--discs.

"In a word, yes. Things are still getting worked out, but it's probably go
title: I Guess I’ll Delete Every PS5 Game I Own To Make Room For FF7 Revelation

author: Steve Watts
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a massive game that can easily last well over 100 hours. But you can actually make it a little less massive with the surprising ability to skip over a whole swath of the game, as players are starting to discover.

Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave consists of four story arcs starring separate protagonists, the four Flame Lords: Cai, Dietrich, Theodora, and Leda. You can play these in any order (though we have some recommendations) and by themselves each of these campaigns can last around 10-20 hours. Each one comes to its own resolution, of sorts. But after you've completed any one of them, you can move onto the next story arc, which starts to tie all the threads together. The fortunes start to weave, you might say. And if you want, you can just skip that part entirely.</
title: The New Fire Emblem Lets You Skip A Massive Chunk Of Fire Emblem

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Bruce Straley, best known for his work at Naughty Dog on the Uncharted and The Last of Us franchises, has apologized to God of War: Laufey studio Santa Monica Studio, after he said he was "not excited" about what the game was offering, at least in some respects.

Straley told Edge that he thinks "every pixel" in Laufey looks "mindblowing and that he is "blown away" by the lengths Santa Monica Studio went to. However, Straley said he is "not excited" by "what you're doing in the game."

Beyond Laufey, Straley said he feels there is "no opportunity to inject fresh, innovative ideas" in AAA games generally.
title: Ex-Naughty Dog Dev Apologizes To God Of War Studio For What He Said About Laufey

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Sony's upcoming Helldivers movie remains in development, and now a key piece of news has surfaced. According to Deadline, Reacher star Alan Ritchson will replace Jason Momoa as the lead, following Momoa's departure earlier this year.

Justin Lin, known for his work on the Fast & Furious and Star Trek franchises, remains attached to the Helldivers movie as director.
title: Very Large Man Could Join Helldivers Movie After A Different Very Large (Aqua)Man Dropped Out

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is shaping up to be the biggest entry in the remake trilogy by a considerable margin, as game director Naoki Hamaguchi estimates that a complete playthrough of everything that the game has to offer could take up to 100 hours. That includes the campaign, side activities, and endgame content--something that Hamaguchi has experienced dozens of times for himself throughout the development of Revelation.

This is all part of the job; to ensure that players enjoy a smooth experience, the developers have to check every part of the game for any potential issues. "In a standard playthrough from beginning to end, if I were to review and check every single asset and element in the game, it'll easily take over a hundred hours," Hamaguchi said to GameSpot. "Obviously, I can't do that in each
title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Could Take 100 Hours To Beat, And Its Director Has Done It 46 Times

author: Dave Irwin
description:
As a series, Fire Emblem has had two standout features compared to other tactical RPGs. First, characters can build relationships with their allies, and in more recent entries, even become romantically involved. Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave doesn't focus on the seduction side at all, preferring to show the camaraderie between teammates. The second feature, one that's been there since the first NES game, is that characters can permanently perish in combat.

Fortune's Weave gives you this option at the beginning of the campaign as Classic Mode. Be warned: this is only for those seeking a brutal challenge. Casual Mode, on the other hand, is a more forgiving way to play through this gargantuan RPG, taking away the stress of potentially leading your allies to their de
title: Should You Play Casual Or Classic Mode In Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave?

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Nintendo recently held two Direct presentations back to back, with fans hoping that the company would reveal a new Mario game of some kind. While that didn't happen, what we did get was the reveal that Mario Kart World is getting some new tracks. Now, though, it seems the company has some more Mario news for us: new logos and renders for everyone's favorite mustachioed plumber.

It seems that over the last day or so, Nintendo quietly updated the look of the "Super Mario" logo. Honestly, the change is subtle. The colors are the same, just a little less vibrant and a little more gradient. The logo is also on one line instead of stacked, as it
title: People Can’t Stop Talking About Mario’s New Tiny Pockets

author: Callum Self
description:
The lowest price that Resident Evil Village, with all of its DLC included, has reached is $14.99 on Steam. Considering it’s one of the best horror games in the world, let alone the franchise itself, that’s already a steal. In fact, I’d be recommending it heavily at that price, but what if I told you that you could get it even cheaper? What if I said you could effectively get an extra game too, while paying less? Well, that’s the deal today.

Even if you haven’t played the rest of the series, Resident Evil Village is a blueprint for how to make a fantastic survival horror game. You play as Ethan, who, fresh off the events of Resident Evil 7, seems to be living a somewhat cozy life. Good for him, at least, until Chris Redfield (a familiar face for fans) bursts into his home, kills
title: Resident Evil Village Gold Edition Is Cheaper Than Ever, And You’re Basically Getting Another Game For Free

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Thirteen years ago, Sony "won" E3 with a simple public service announcement that dunked on Microsoft's controversial Xbox One DRM plans. All it took was 22 seconds for Sony's Shuhei Yoshida and Adam Boyes to show how game sharing would work on the PS4, resulting in a huge PR win for the company. Fast-forward to 2026, and at the Tokyo Game Show, Yoshida and Boyes reunited to recreate that meme, but with a big difference: This time, there's no disc to pass between friends.

The original video from Sony--which was infamously put together at the last second--showed just how easy it was for PS4 owners to share physical games, compared with the frequent DRM checks that were initially planned for Xbox One games. Boyes left Sony in 2016, while Yos
title: Sony’s Iconic PS4 Game-Sharing Meme Has Been Recreated To Capture Our Depressing Future

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
BambooHR, a human resources company that provides software-as-a-service for more than 30,000 companies, has released data that suggests people are taking time off to play GTA 6 this November.

You might have seen anecdotes online, or even stories from people you know in real life, about skipping work on November 19 to play GTA 6. BambooHR's data, though, shows a more concrete trend.
title: A Lot Of People Are Seemingly Taking Time Off Work To Play GTA 6. Are You?

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Everyone has that one boss fight they hate. Malenia in Elden Ring. Sephiroth in Kingdom Hearts. Shao Khan in Mortal Kombat. Ultimecia in Final Fantasy VIII. Plenty of big-bads strike fear in the hearts of even the most hardened gamers, and while many send shivers down my spine, there's one I was glad I'd never face again: Lu Bu in Team Ninja's Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty ... or so I thought.

Ahead of the release of the action game studio's upcom
title: Wo Long 2’s Demo Revives My Greatest Nightmare

description: Grave is back in action in GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E: BLOOD HEAT. Get a new look at the game’s over-the-top combat, featuring the new Parry and Parry Counter mechanics, explosive gunplay, and Grave’s new close-range attacks.
title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Blood Heat – Action Gameplay Trailer

description:
Sony recently launched "Live TV on PS5," an offering that gives all PlayStation 5 owners access to 100+ channels of free ad-supported TV and movies. Keith Le Goy, the chairman of Sony Pictures TV, recently discussed the reasoning behind launching the service and why he believes it represents "one plus one equaling a lot more than two."

Speaking to Variety, Le Goy said PS5 already has 40-50 million people who are "incredibly engaged" with gaming, but also
title: Sony Says Free TV On PS5 Is “One Plus One Equaling A Lot More Than Two”

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Aniimo is a complex creature-catching game, and one of the big features of the world revolves around nurturing. This allows you to raise the Prismana Flow in the area, increase your chances of encountering special Aniimo, and more. You want to be utilizing the nurture feature early on in your playthrough, so you can progress faster and encounter more Aniimo types. In this guide, we'll explain what nurturing means and how you can quickly level up this feature.

Nurturing system and blooms explained
title: How To Use The Aniimo Nurturing Feature

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Do you want to unlock all Vampirism abilities in The Blood of Dawnwalker? As someone who turns into a creature of the night, you have several ways to reach your full capabilities. However, you must feast not only on hapless foes, but also on the vrakhiri lords themselves. Our guide has all the details that you need, but be forewarned that there will be spoilers, too.

Vampirism abilities - Unlocking via corruption, quests, blood phials, and bosses

title: How To Unlock All Vampirism Abilities In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Blood Phial Locations Guide

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The best tool you can own in life is a hammer, and in Control Resonant, fixing Manhattan requires a VERY big one to perform some percussive maintenance. The Aberrant is the melee weapon that you'll wield in battle, and while it can take a variety of forms, it looks especially satisfying to morph it into a gigantic hammer that wouldn't look out of place in a Looney Tunes cartoon if Rob Zombie were directing it. But what would that version of the Aberrant look like in real life? Pretty intimidating and impractical, it turns out.

Ahead of Control Resonant's release next week, the blacksmiths of Man at Arms took a stab at building the Aberrant. In an episode of their YouTube series--and sponsored by Control Resonant developer Remedy Entertainment--the team put together a solid replica, but for the hammerhead itself, the
title: Blacksmiths Discover Control Resonant’s Massive Hammer Is Simply Too Much Hammer

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger officially releases today, September 18, but like many big movies, it actually debuted the night prior. The movie made $9 million or more in the US for its Thursday previews, according to Deadline, and that's a record for the series.

Experts predict the movie will make between $40 million and $50 million for its first weekend in the US, and now it could go higher, the report said.
title: The Resident Evil Movie Is Already Breaking Records

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Remedy Entertainment's signature style has often made gameplay feel secondary to story. Games like Alan Wake, Quantum Break, and Control had fun gameplay hooks, but the depth mostly lived in their narrative puzzle-boxes, where the answer to each strange mystery created three more questions. Control Resonant breaks from tradition magnificently, revealing a whole new side to Remedy. Armed with deep, engaging combat mechanics in a stunning version of Manhattan that is unforgettable, Control Resonant is a confident delivery of Remedy's best gameplay experience ever that never sacrifices the team's unique brand of weirdness. 

Control Resonant takes place seven years after the first game, with the mystical Oldest House still under siege from the Hiss invasion. Now, outside the Oldest House's once-secret doors, a second Altered World Event is threatening Manhattan. With Federal Bureau of Control director Jesse Faden gone
title: Control Resonant’s Best Aspect Left Me Utterly Speechless

author: Erick Tay
description: Remedy's signature weirdness elevates the best gameplay experience it's ever made.
title: Control Resonant’s Best Aspect Left Me Utterly Speechless – Review

author: S.E. Doster
description:
One of Aniimo's questlines will take you on a hunt for mysterious cubes around Astra's Northside. This quest is rewarding, but it's a bit tricky because it doesn't fully guide you with quest markers. In this guide, we'll show you how to unlock the Mysterious Presence quest and how to collect all Voxel Cubes to complete it.

How to unlock the Mysterious Presence quest

You've likely spent most of your time hunting Aniimo and doing main story quests in Idyll, but you'll want to visit the city of Astra to get access to the Mysterious Presence questline as well as others.
title: How To Complete The Aniimo Mysterious Presence Quest

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The Far Cry TV series for FX is starting to take shape, as new cast members for the anthology series have been announced. Joining Rob Mac (who is also a co-showrunner alongside Noah Hawley) are Lizzy Caplan and Steve Buscemi, along with several new faces, including Brendan Gleeson, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Hamish Linklater, Jamie Demetriou, and Sam Spruell.

According to Variety, all of those actors will appear in the first season of Far Cry, making for a pretty stacked cast. Leigh earned acclaim for her roles in Hateful Eight and Fargo, Spruell was recently seen in Game of Thrones: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, Demetrio
title: Far Cry TV Series Adds Batman, Knuckles McGinty, And More Big Names

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Robberies will play a huge part in GTA 6, but there's more than meets the eye. Based on what we know so far, basically any store you walk into can be robbed, but there are different tiers to robberies.

At the lowest level, any convenience store, or any small local store you walk into, you can rob. These are not marked on the map, they're just stores you'll stumble across during your adventures through Leonida. It sounds like these robberies will get you a small amount of cash in a pinch, but if you want to start pulling off grander heists, you'll need to look for bigger jobs.

These robberies do show up on the map, but not right away. In order to find them, you need to explore the map, get tips from NPCs, or maybe overhear something. While we don't know all the ways these robbery opp
title: GTA 6’s Robberies Need To Be Unpredictable

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
A huge batch of previously leaked Rockstar files has resurfaced online, giving players a new look at Grand Theft Auto 5's canceled content, including a surprisingly massive Liberty City expansion and the long-rumored Agent Trevor DLC.

The files reportedly total around 192GB, dwarfing the roughly 4GB collection of GTA 5 source code material that surfaced publicly in 2023. GTA modder TJGM has been digging through the newly accessible files and has already highlighted several discoveries, including cut dialogue, canceled missions, development tools, and assets from Rockstar's planned single-player expansions.

One of the biggest discoveries so far is a look at the Liberty City expansion that Rockstar had planned for GTA 5, but ultimately was canned.
title: New GTA 5 Source Code Leak Is Uncovering A Ton Of Cut Content

author: Kevin Knezevic
description:
A formidable new Mega-Evolved Pokemon is swooping into Pokemon Go this weekend. Mega Staraptor will appear in Gyms for a limited time as part of the game's latest Super Mega Raid Day, which takes place on September 19.

Like many other Pokemon, Staraptor doesn't just receive a significant stat boost upon Mega Evolving; it also changes types. Whereas its standard form is normal and flying, Mega Staraptor becomes fighting and flying, making it an even more potent force in battle.

To help you conquer the new Mega Raid boss, we've put together some tips on how to beat Mega Staraptor, including some recommended counters and the best moves to teach your own Staraptor.
title: Mega Staraptor Pokemon Go Raids: Weaknesses, Best Counters, And Best Moveset
